notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
My fellow survivors,

as promised before, here's what we've been working on.

So, as you probably now, the game was playable but didn't have too many features yet. We're building on that base now and are improving many aspects, while adding completely new ones. The overall experience should be improved, the game looks and feels way better now.
With increased population of the world, the game feels more alive and things like horses you can use as mounts, or a generally better AI makes the gameplay more enjoyable.
The performance got better and many errors are fixed.

We are also already working on our next update focused on adding more longtime motivation for the people who are in for a story, rather than having nothing to do but to hoard resources.

Here's a list, of most of the changes. Have fun and stay tuned!

[list]
[*] [b]Features[/b]

[*] New Main Menu
[*] New Settings Menu
[*] New High Quality Animation System
[*] New Character animations with better transitions
[*] New Riding system added
[*] New swimming system
[*] Better Splash Effects
[*] New underwater rendering
[*] More realistic Character movement
[*] New foot Ik for more realistic movement
[*] Added Footprints to enable tracking
[*] New Dynamic Animal AI
[*] Added Animal Childrens
[*] Aging of Children and Animals
[*] New animals in all regions (water, ground, air)
[*] New deer species , man woman and childrens
[*] New bear species , man and woman
[*] New pumas species  , man and woman
[*] New rabbits species
[*] New wolf species 
[*] New animals Animations (water, ground)
[*] Replaced old animals with better models and animations
[*] Advanced AI damage system
[*] Way more life across the map, with increased animal spawns
[*] Better performance and lighting
[*] Added LODs for all objects
[*] Improved spawning in players surrounding
[*] Improved networking of characters and weapons

[*] [b]Fixes[/b]

[*] Fixed armor amount
[*] Fixed where weapon animations didn't work for clients
[*] Fixed equipment not loading on newly connected clients
[*] Fixed weapons not attached for new clients
[*] Fixed save system loading duplicated grids for new clients 
[*] Fixed full auto shooting not updating location
[*] Fixed shift click moving of items to convert component 
[*] Fixed grids not loading properly
[*] Fixed sounds not playing at weapon location 
[*] Fixed crafting at full weight not dropping item
[*] Fixed weapons not saving correctly
[*] Fixed empty fire sound not playing
[*] Fixed weapon attachments & condition not saving
[*] Fixed players can now build in plot pole zones
[*] Fixed resource saving
[*] Fixed weight displaying zero
[*] Fixed inventory slots error 
[*] Fixed outline highlight after death
[*] Fixed crafting at full weight not dropping item
[*] Fixed badge at max health 
[*] Fixed death bag desync
[*] Fixed new client foliage not being removed 
[*] Fixed doors not opening on new clients 
[*] Fixed ammo in weapons when looting corpses
[*] Fixed equipment adding to loot bag
[*] Fixed single player using 2 ammo per shot
[*] Fixed Door networking issue
[*] Fixed take damage disabled not working
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32945798/7fe9100923c3940db1399329c67253e2de271471.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello wild survivors,

This is our Second big update in only 12 days. 

We changed many general things which wasn't tested well or been missed. We worked on the map and the NPC’s. Sounds been fixed and the hole menu is reworked. You can communicate with other players by voice and text and the saving system is improved. 


[code][list]   
[*]added singleplayer (different save system)
[*]added the possibility to find friends on servers
[*]added in the new mexico villages loot 
[*]added wild horses (harmless) (in future updates you can tame and ride with them)
[*]added snake (Aggressive)
[*]added a Map  (key *M*) (will be reworked in the next updates)
[*]added a chat system (press *Enter* to open)(will be reworked in the next updates)
[*]added a voice chat system (key *T*)(will be improved in the next updates)
[*]added refilling of your thirst when you jump into water and gives you on top of your normal thirst 10 points more 
[*]added more fiber plants to farm
[*]added more lakes 
[*]added more roads 
[*]added new Civilian animations (reactions) and sounds
[*]added more Buildings 
[*]added destructible effect for fort wall, fort door, door frame, wooden door
[*]added more random respawn points near the starter cities
[*]added key bind mapping under options and controls (actually now you can’t change)

[*]changed melee attack sounds for knife
[*]changed dog attack hit sounds
[*]changed scorpion attack hit sounds
[*]changed Chicken AI attention
[*]changed Skeleton AI
[*]changed the hole Menu
[*]changed the loading screen

[*]fixed the volume settings
[*]fixed some lightning issues
[*]fixed ping error
[*]fixed the random damage of harmless NPC's
[*]fixed saving problems
[*]fixed names in the crafting list
[*]fixed the scorpion (takes range damage now)
[/list][/code][/b]

We worked as well on the dedicated Server System, but we are still having view issues which we need to improve, we will bring the Dedicated Server with Community Servers asap out.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32945798/234c34a8c8c1dca682a2a377e44a3587c95eb5b1.jpg[/img]
